name: Threat modeling
description: The adversary applies threat modeling methodologies to identify threats and determine appropriate countermeasures.

subtechniques.name: Avoid single-point-of-failure (SPOF)
subtechniques.description: Single points of failure could crumble sensitive activities and lead to de-anonymization and should therefore be avoided.

subtechniques.name: CIA-triad
subtechniques.description: Confidentiality, integrity and availability, the CIA-triad is a security model which could be applied for threat modeling and risk management.

subtechniques.name: Determine countermeasures
subtechniques.description: Based on threat modeling and risk management practices, appropriate countermeasures can be determined.

subtechniques.name: Determine risks
subtechniques.description: Based on threat modeling and risk management practices, risks can be determined.

subtechniques.name: Determine threats
subtechniques.description: Based on threat modeling and risk management practices, threats can be determined.

subtechniques.name: Determine vulnerabilities
subtechniques.description: Based on threat modeling and risk management practices, vulnerabilities can be determined.

subtechniques.name: Determine what needs protection
subtechniques.description: Based on threat modeling and risk management practices, what needs protection the most can be determined.

subtechniques.name: Evade extradiction
subtechniques.description: To evade extradition, cybercriminals might travel to countries which do not have any extradition treaty with their own country.

subtechniques.name: Exit plan
subtechniques.description: Exit plans might be prepared in case worse things happen, such as arrested by law enforcement. These plan could make sure that their activities continue or that others can access certain resources.

procedures.name: LINDDUN
procedures.description: LINDDUN is a privacy threat modeling framework. https://linddun.org/

procedures.name: PASTA
procedures.description: Process for Attack Simulation and Threat Analysis (PASTA) is a risk-centric threat modeling method. https://cdn2.hubspot.net/hubfs/4598121/Content%20PDFs/VerSprite-PASTA-Threat-Modeling-Process-for-Attack-Simulation-Threat-Analysis.pdf

procedures.name: STRIDE
procedures.description: STRIDE is a model of threats, used to help reason and find threats to a system. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/STRIDE_model
